title: 通胀数据不理想：油价已跌24%，汽油柴油价格会跟着回落吗？
speaker: Chris Falen

segments.en: Inflation yes it did come in hot What I think is going on is when oil prices go up with a lag
segments.zh: 通胀确实高企。我认为情况是，油价上涨后，有滞后效应。

segments.en: Gas and diesel prices go up and then with another lag Stuff that depends on gas and diesel goes up So I think that's what we're seeing is higher gas and diesel prices due to high oil prices filtering through the economy
segments.zh: 汽油和柴油价格随之上涨，然后又有另一个滞后，依赖汽油和柴油的东西也涨价。所以我认为我们看到的是，高油价导致汽油和柴油价格上涨，并传导至经济。

segments.en: I guess the silver lining for this cloud and it is a cloud I don't want to say that this is a good number it's not The silver lining is that so far in November Brent crude is down 24%
segments.zh: 我想这乌云中的一线希望是，这确实是乌云，我不想说这是好数据，它不是。一线希望是，11月至今布伦特原油下跌了24%。

segments.en: And so assuming that stays will basically see this in reverse Things that depend you know oil and gas should come down
segments.zh: 假设这持续下去，基本上会看到相反的过程。依赖油气的东西应该会降价。

segments.en: Diesel and gas should come down and then things that depend on diesel and gas should come down in the coming months Is there enough in this report to really suggest that inflation is indeed becoming more entrenched instead of gradually cooling a sum may suggest
segments.zh: 柴油和汽油应该会降价，然后依赖柴油和汽油的东西在未来几个月也应该会降价。这份报告是否足以表明通胀确实变得更加根深蒂固，而不是逐渐降温？有些人可能这样认为。
